test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

He had cleaned the bathroom.

options.text: The bathroom has cleaned by him.
The bathroom had cleaned by him.
The bathroom had been cleaned by him.
The bathroom has been cleaned by him.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He had cleaned the bathroom."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the bathroom" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had cleaned" to "had been cleaned" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The bathroom had been cleaned by him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The bathroom has cleaned by him." – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 2: **"The bathroom had cleaned by him." – Incorrect structure without the auxiliary verb "been".
 
• **Option 4: **"The bathroom has been cleaned by him." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).

``
